description:
Create or update a markdown note in the vault. The note is written to disk and indexed automatically.

Optionally specify source files to enable provenance tracking — SAME will flag this note as stale if sources change.

Args:
  path: Relative path within the vault (e.g. 'decisions/auth-approach.md')
  content: Markdown content to write
  append: If true, append to existing file instead of overwriting (default false)
  agent: Optional writer attribution stored in frontmatter (e.g. 'codex')
  sources: File paths that this note was derived from (optional)

Returns confirmation with the saved path.

append.description: Append to existing file instead of overwriting

path.description: Relative path within the vault (e.g. decisions/auth.md)

sources.description: File paths that this note was derived from or references. SAME tracks these to detect when source material changes, flagging the note as potentially stale.

name: save_note
